result: tests green

why: One SSE connection and one engine owner removes duplicates

decision: Ran full suite plus typecheck plus lint plus production build
why: Each gate checks a different failure class
evidence: npm test, npx tsc --noEmit, npm run lint, npm run build
result: 256 passed, 0 errors

decision: Keep HEX_SIZE and fix plot spacing through Colony-owned anchor exclusion
why: Resizing the global hex grid would move persisted plots and alter terrain/scatter coordinate assumptions; axial distance 3 gives 7.794 units between anchors against 7.2-unit deck diameter
result: Phase 1.1B plan; v2 migration required

decision: Use explicit two-ring specialist layout plus separate orchestrator slot
why: Modulo-eight placement wraps the 15-seat roster; radii 1.3 and 2.5 plus orchestrator radius 3.2 fit inside the 3.6-unit deck and preserve stable seat positions
result: Phase 1.1C plan

decision: Rewrite all surviving astronaut slots after removal
why: Agent cap is 64; full compaction is smaller and less error-prone than maintaining swap indexes across seven instanced meshes and attributes
result: Phase 1.1D plan

decision: Keep local live clock and manual time mode, but drive both through one pure staged lighting profile
why: Current ThreeSky uses Date.now correctly but reaches Terra ambient 0.05 at midnight and has no dusk model; explicit day/dusk/night outputs make floor and transitions testable without complex shaders
result: Phase 1.5 plan; target night ambient floor 0.12 effective minimum

decision: Require real WebGL acceptance for instancing and night readability in addition to unit tests
why: CPU matrices and shader source checks cannot prove GPU transforms or visual contrast; browser checks cover the failure modes that caused the 3D boot and night regressions
result: Manual gate added

decision: Keep credential-bearing smoke logs out of commits and record rotation/deletion as a release prerequisite
why: dev-smoke-3dfix.log contains a bearer credential in a request URL; documentation must not reproduce it
result: Manual hygiene gate added

decision: Reserve retained fallow anchors before assigning active plots; actives win legacy ties
why: Fallow-blind assignment let a new floor steal returning ground (caught by exclusion test); reservation keeps exclusion total while active priority preserves first-plot stability
result: Implemented; tests green

decision: Prove browser instancing with alternating-toggle lock-in, not single A/B
why: Live monitor sessions drift between captures and confound A/B pixel diffs; cells changing on all 4 W/I transitions isolate the controlled signal
result: 284 locked cells, 0 errors

decision: Raise night floor to 0.22 ambient plus 0.3 cool fill after measurement
why: Planned 0.12 floor measured 0.67 mean luminance (unreadable); 0.22 plus directional fill reads 5.7 with faint structure and bright markers, sun still zero
result: Implemented; browser-measured

decision: Correct boot-clock contract to frozen-sky and share conversion via lighting-time
why: 1970-epoch misuse reads timezone-dependent (08:00 here), not night; new module also keeps three.js out of the 2D day-night bundle
result: Implemented; tests green

decision: Ignore dev smoke logs via .gitignore; credential rotation still manual
why: Logs stay untracked and uncommittable; token in dev-smoke-3dfix.log was never printed and must be rotated by owner if still valid
result: Hygiene gate added

decision: Keep runtime movement in an engine-owned AgentMotionController keyed by WorldAgent.id
why: WorldState remains renderer-neutral while stable IDs support arrival, departure, and return cancellation
result: Implemented; behavior tests pass

decision: Use a fixed-step A* grid with buildings, scatter, and ship obstacles
why: One deterministic grid handles reroutes, bounds, diagonal corners, and exact endpoints without adding route state to React
result: Implemented; navigation tests pass

decision: Attach transit anchors to rendered ship geometry and queue agents across six lanes
why: Geometry-derived points keep movement on the visible ramp; lane queues prevent full-floor departure overlap
result: Implemented; ship and 20-agent departure tests pass

decision: Use element-owned pointer input with viewport-aware framing and active-floor focus
why: One controller supports mouse and touch, avoids global listener leaks, and fits portrait viewports with horizontal FOV
result: Implemented; camera tests and browser input pass

decision: Snap movement and camera state and clear particles when reduced motion is enabled
why: The preference must stop both new motion and animation already in progress
result: Implemented; unit and browser checks pass

decision: Require full tests, build, and real WebGL mouse, touch, and reduced-motion checks for Phase 2
why: Unit tests prove state transitions; production browser input proves canvas event wiring and responsive output
evidence: npm test, npx tsc --noEmit, npm run lint, npm run build, Temp/opencode/webgl-verify/phase2-interactions.mjs
result: 325 passed; build clean; browser errors zero

decision: Project monitor facts through one renderer-neutral ActivityModel
why: Both renderers need identical endpoint, lifecycle, outcome, and standby decisions without adding presentation state to WorldState
result: Implemented; focused tests pass

decision: Keep missing endpoints null and unknown outcomes neutral
why: A missing producer fact cannot justify a delegation edge, success beat, or error beat
result: Implemented; producer copies match byte-for-byte

decision: Use 2D routed handoffs and 3D invocation arcs from the same direct relation
why: 2D can reuse sprite gestures while 3D must keep astronauts at their worksites
result: Implemented; unit and browser checks pass

decision: Hold missing idle specialists onsite for 25 seconds before departure
why: Short idle gaps must not trigger visible churn; stable IDs cancel standby or reverse departure
result: Implemented; exact-boundary and cancellation tests pass

decision: Map 2D and 3D selection through stable actor IDs and reuse AgentInspector
why: Raycast instance IDs and keyboard traversal need one actor identity before resolving inspector content
result: Implemented; desktop, mobile, and reduced-motion browser checks pass

decision: Run Phase 2.5 browser proof on an isolated port
why: The user-owned port 3001 served stale chunk errors after build output changed; restarting that process was forbidden
result: Port 3011 passed and was stopped; port 3001 restart remains manual

decision: Derive grouped session summaries client-side while retaining one active renderer
why: Existing V2 snapshot already contains required floor, actor, and invocation facts; a second renderer would duplicate expensive scene ownership
result: Implemented; deterministic model tests and one-canvas browser proof pass

decision: Retain closed floors in V2 client state but filter them at renderer boundaries
why: Recent completion history needs floor metadata while 2D and 3D must never render closed workspaces
result: Implemented; completed session remains comparable and canvas count stays one

decision: Generate lifecycle notifications from snapshot transitions with baseline suppression and stable dedupe IDs
why: Server persistence and cross-tab locks are unnecessary for current in-app awareness; initial snapshots must not create false alerts
result: Implemented; transition tests and live quiet-to-working browser check pass

decision: Exercise grouped navigation, keyboard selection, comparison, notifications, responsive layout, and renderer ownership on isolated production server
why: Unit and type gates cannot prove modal wiring, SSE transitions, responsive overflow, or duplicate WebGL ownership
result: Desktop, 390x844 mobile, and reduced motion pass with zero browser errors and one canvas

decision: Seed only default-visible roles and keep all other supported roles dynamic
why: Unused optional roles must not occupy permanent desks, but runtime observation must retain full agent support
result: Eleven defaults seed; build, plan, general, and scout remain supported optional roles

decision: Order default seats first and render occupied desks on a four-column grid
why: Contiguous canonical seats remove empty holes while keeping one layout source for actors, handoffs, labels, and lights
result: Eleven default desks form 4-4-3 rows; observed build appends at seat 11

decision: Fit 2D office to actual content container with sidebar-aware inset and dark viewport framing
why: Using 100vw inside sidebar content caused clipping and made extra width read as empty beige office floor
result: Open and closed sidebar, optional role, mobile, and delegation checks pass with zero browser errors

decision: Centralize role visual identity before changing either renderer
why: One role mapping prevents 2D desk props and 3D suit styling from drifting while deterministic fallback keeps future roles supported
result: All registry roles covered; identity tests pass

decision: Batch 3D role accessories by six visual families
why: Six fixed instanced meshes preserve shared astronaut geometry and avoid one mesh or draw call per agent
result: Accessory family visibility, compaction, and instancing tests pass

decision: Keep semantic indicators stronger than role styling and prove both renderers in isolated browser
why: Role identity must aid recognition without replacing working, outcome, selection, or accessibility signals
result: 11 role accents, semantic working override, one canvas, reduced-motion 3D accessories, mobile containment, zero browser errors

decision: Separate researcher sensor from architect document and reinforce semantic markers
why: Role silhouette, activity, outcome, delegation, and selection must remain readable before decorative identity
result: Implemented; focused and full tests pass

decision: Remove geometry vertex colors from per-instance accessory and backpack materials
why: Geometry has no color attribute, so enabling vertex colors multiplied valid instance colors by WebGL default black
result: Final WebGL frame shows intended light role details

decision: Keep user port 3001 untouched and document production fixture limits
why: Next dev prevents a second server in one working tree, while production route modules do not share the in-memory fixture store deterministically
result: Required frame set captured; selection-dialog detail recapture remains a harness limitation, not a product gate

decision: Raise full-night ambient to 0.48 and cool directional fill to 0.65
why: Live night screenshot left terrain, buildings, and work plots near-black despite prior measured floor
result: Regression failed at prior 0.22 ambient, then 371 tests passed with brighter profile

decision: Use one canonical Cozy theme across UI, generated office assets, and Three.js materials
why: Shared tokens keep status meaning and environment color consistent without coupling character identity to runtime state
result: Implemented; schema, contrast, and material tests pass

decision: Compose 48px role atlases from permanent source layers at build time
why: Layer recipes preserve reusable project-original art while runtime loading stays a static manifest lookup

decision: Wait for a complete FPS window and derive one shared bounds sphere per moving instance batch
why: Startup sample counts were not FPS, and per-mesh Three.js bounds scans repeated the same position work
result: Independent re-review passed; frustum culling retained

decision: Use 1024px as the single session-navigator breakpoint
